sql:
SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS average_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL;
